title: Measured browser telemetry and cached-base native scaling
hypothesis: Validated resource observations will expose repeated immutable-base payloads, and a content-addressed native cache will eliminate warm-assignment base and adapter fetches at both T1 and a 91.5M-parameter T2 profile without violating checkpoint parity or held-out-loss guardrails.

use_case.claim: Select the first native execution profile and its next optimization from measured runtime, payload, memory, storage, numerical, and TinyStories held-out behavior rather than architecture preference.

baseline.label: Connected CPU/WASM browser worker
baseline.description: Two authenticated CPU/WASM assignments fetch the immutable base and current adapter through the worker API and report complete resource observations.

primary_metric.label: Warm base payload avoidance ratio
primary_metric.description: Fraction of the immutable base response payload avoided by the second native assignment using the same content-addressed local cache.

repeated_validation_suite.label: T1 and 91.5M-parameter T2 cached-base profiles
repeated_validation_suite.description: Run two authenticated native assignments with one shared cache at each scale, aggregate one canonical adapter step, and evaluate the resulting checkpoint on frozen TinyStories validation sequences.

final_holdout_suite.label: Frozen TinyStories validation profile
final_holdout_suite.description: Compare initialization and step-1 held-out cross-entropy on the campaign-declared frozen validation prefix at each scale.

guardrails.label: Canonical adapter checkpoint parity
guardrails.description: Each native profile must remain below 1e-6 relative L2 against the independent centralized adapter step.

guardrails.label: Held-out loss non-regression
guardrails.description: Step-1 held-out mean loss must not exceed initialization at either real-data profile.

guardrails.label: Complete privacy-filtered telemetry
guardrails.description: Both assignments at every profile must report validated observations while the public aggregate omits device capacity and JS heap limit.

guardrails.label: Real connected Burn worker proof
guardrails.description: Two authenticated CPU/WASM assignments must populate runtime, payload, memory, and storage cards while preserving the established adapter checkpoint parity bound.

independent_variables.label: Worker runtime
independent_variables.description: Burn CPU/WASM browser versus native Python/PyTorch CPU.

independent_variables.label: Artifact cache state
independent_variables.description: Cold content-addressed cache versus a validated warm cache.

independent_variables.label: Model scale
independent_variables.description: T1 at 6,901,760 parameters versus T2 at 91,544,064 parameters.

controlled_variables.label: Adapter-gradient contract
controlled_variables.description: Rank-4 alpha-8 frozen-base QKV LoRA, complete summed FP32 gradients, and one coordinator-owned AdamW update.

controlled_variables.label: Frozen TinyStories artifacts
controlled_variables.description: Both native scales use dataset manifest 99e5642b and tokenizer 7cb0fc24.

controlled_variables.label: Two-way global step
controlled_variables.description: Two authenticated assignments each process one context-256 sequence and aggregate once.
